entities.summary: Claudio Bisogniero is a retired Italian diplomat. From 2007 until 2012, he was the Deputy Secretary General of NATO before serving as Ambassador to the United States (2012–2016). From 2016 until 2019 he was Italy’s Permanent Representative to NATO.
